description: [Kimai](https://kimai.org/) is a professional grade time-tracking application, free and open-source. It handles use-cases of freelancers as well as companies with dozens or hundreds of users. Kimai was build to track your project times and ships with many advanced features, including but not limited to: JSON API, invoicing, data exports, multi-timer and punch-in punch-out mode, tagging, multi-user - multi-timezones - multi-language ([over 30 translations existing](https://hosted.weblate.org/projects/kimai/)!), authentication via SAML/LDAP/Database, two-factor authentication (2FA) with TOTP, customizable role and team permissions, responsive design, user/customer/project specific rates, advanced search & filtering, money and time budgets, advanced reporting, support for [plugins](https://www.kimai.org/store/) and so much more. Esta é uma demonstração efêmera: o navegador roda isolado no Kasm e o serviço de backend é criado e removido automaticamente quando a sessão inicia e termina.
notes: Teste efêmero do template Portainer 'Kimai'. Backend Docker esperado: contêiner 'kimai' (imagem linuxserver/kimai:latest), na rede kasm_default_network, escutando na porta interna 443. URL alvo: http://kimai:443. O orquestrador inicia o backend quando uma sessão desta workspace é detectada e o remove quando a última sessão termina. Se a página exibir erro de conexão nos primeiros segundos, aguarde alguns instantes e recarregue.
